screening_population: 120707 asymptomatic newborns; symptomatic cohort analysed separately; prenatal major CHD excluded; source/Cochrane characterization allows all gestational ages and NICU status
screening_algorithm_raw: pre/postductal pulse oximetry; positive if <95% in right hand and foot on two measures 4 h apart, >3% difference on two measures, or any value <90%
study_target_definition_raw: critical CHD = defect causing death or needing intervention before 28 days
diagnosis_categories_raw: source critical CHD; other CHD; PPHN; lung problem; prematurity; infection; true false positives
diagnosis_counts_raw: pulse-ox source critical detections: critical PS10, TOF9, truncus2, single ventricle8, PA30, TGA32, DORV8, HLHS3, CoA3, IAA2, critical AS1, TAPVC14 =122; source CCHD false positives394, of whom 180 required medical intervention/further monitoring = other CHD90 + PPHN41 + lung23 + preterm16 + infection10; remaining true false positives214
individual_diagnoses: critical PS10; TOF9; truncus2; single ventricle8; PA30; TGA32; DORV8; HLHS3; CoA3; IAA2; critical AS1; TAPVC14
lesion_mapping_status: Standalone TGA32 is treated as simple TGA because the source tabulates DORV and single-ventricle anatomy separately. Critical PS10, TOF9, PA30, CoA3, AS1 and TAPVC14 satisfy their locked conditional rule because source critical classification itself requires death/intervention before 28 days; HLHS3 and IAA2 are unconditional. Thus 104 harmonized CCHD are removed. Truncus2 + single ventricle8 + DORV8 are not automatic harmonized CCHD and re-enter the denominator.
management_actionability_evidence: Among the 394 source false positives, 180 are explicitly stated to have required medical intervention or further monitoring; these are CAN-AB180. The 18 re-entered source-critical structural diagnoses are clinically relevant and satisfy a source definition of death OR intervention before 28 days, but intervention is not separable from death at case level; they are conservatively CAN-U18 rather than automatically Strict. The remaining 214 are explicitly treated by the source as true false positives after removal of the medically consequential group -> aggregate NON_CAN214.
poolability_reason: complete point denominator and actionability ascertainment, but source population permits asymptomatic NICU/higher-acuity infants and outcomes are not separable by nursery/NICU setting
source_full_text_provenance: Zhao QM et al. Lancet. 2014;384:747-754. PMID 24768155; DOI 10.1016/S0140-6736(14)60198-7. Author-uploaded full text independently reverified.
extraction_notes: Strict180/412; Expanded198/412; NON_CAN214. Large high-information unit retained for mixed-setting sensitivity analysis. Source critical definition matches <=28-day timing but the review lesion list still governs membership.

screening_population: term/post-term newborns; premature infants excluded; maternity/private-hospital newborn screening
screening_algorithm_raw: both hands and one foot; <90% positive; 90-95% plus >3% pre/post difference provisional positive with repeat; three repeated positives -> same-day echo
study_target_definition_raw: source separates major CHD from minor CHD; critical framework cites duct-dependent disease and death/intervention <=28 days but the 12 screen-positive major CHD are not individually proven to meet that timing
diagnosis_categories_raw: major CHD; minor CHD; healthy; PPHN; sepsis; RDS; birth asphyxia
diagnosis_counts_raw: major CHD12 = TGA2, TOF2, tricuspid atresia1, HLHS1, pulmonary atresia2, AVSD2, CoA2; minor CHD33 = isolated PDA5, mixed PDA8, VSD8, ASD10, PS2; no intracardiac CHD55 = healthy27, PPHN6, sepsis13, RDS4, birth asphyxia5
individual_diagnoses: TGA2; TOF2; tricuspid atresia1; HLHS1; PA2; AVSD2; CoA2; isolated PDA5; mixed PDA8; VSD8; ASD10; PS2; PPHN6; sepsis13; RDS4; birth asphyxia5; healthy27
lesion_mapping_status: Standalone TGA2 + HLHS1 are definite harmonized CCHD. TOF2 and CoA2 are conditional without documented <=28-day event and remain denominator. Tricuspid atresia1 and AVSD2 are not automatic target lesions. Pulmonary atresia2 lacks septal anatomy: if PA/IVS they are harmonized CCHD; otherwise they remain. Minor pulmonary stenosis2 is conditional without qualifying event and remains.
management_actionability_evidence: No diagnosis-specific treatment/escalation/disposition/follow-up consequence is documented for the 28 noncardiac pathologies or for the re-entered structural lesions; they remain CAN-U. Minor PDA/ASD/VSD findings are NON_CAN. Healthy27 is explicit. Strict remains 0 throughout admissible mappings.
poolability_reason: complete clinical classification but pulmonary-atresia septal anatomy prevents a point harmonized denominator; screening was very early (3-6 h)
source_full_text_provenance: Salih AF et al. Kurdistan J Appl Res. 2018; DOI 10.24017/science.2018.2.22. Detailed same-cohort companion: Sattar RA et al. Merit Res J Med Med Sci. 2014;2(2):54-60, independently reverified full-text PDF; screenshot retrieval was attempted and returned cache miss.
extraction_notes: The 2014 Sattar report has the same investigators, N=2181, 100 positive screens, CHD45, major12, minor33, FP55 and pathology counts as R135 and is treated as a post-freeze companion/provenance source only, never a new weight. If PA2=PA/IVS: denom95, CAN-U37, NON_CAN31, healthy27. If PA2 remains harmonized-negative: denom97, CAN-U39, NON_CAN31, healthy27.

screening_population: apparently healthy newborns in rooming-in; intermittent implementation evolving to universal screening
screening_timing_raw: before discharge per SIBEN implementation; exact age not reported
screening_algorithm_raw: SIBEN pulse-ox screening algorithm with repeats; persistent positive -> clinical/cardiology evaluation
study_target_definition_raw: CCHD screening; no CCHD diagnosed among screened final positives
management_actionability_evidence: The sole final-positive infant had normal echocardiogram, was admitted to NICU and required supplemental oxygen for 5 days specifically because of severe transient tachypnea -> CAN-A1.
poolability_reason: well-baby rooming-in screening population; exact final-fail denominator and diagnosis; direct acute disposition/treatment consequence; 100% ascertainment
source_full_text_provenance: Sola A et al. Int J Neonatal Screen. 2020;6(1):21. PMCID PMC7422978; DOI 10.3390/ijns6010021.
extraction_notes: 28 failed first test; 25 passed repeat; 3 required a further repeat; only one ultimately had a positive POS. Do not count initial/repeat-normalized screens. Strict=Expanded=1/1.

screening_population: healthy newborn screening in private maternity hospital; >1000 infants underwent POS during 2/2019-1/2020
screening_timing_raw: early-discharge context; exact POS age not reported
screening_algorithm_raw: routine POS; failed tests evaluated by pediatric cardiology with echocardiography
study_target_definition_raw: source CCHD = TGA1 + pulmonary valve atresia1
diagnosis_counts_raw: TGA1; pulmonary valve atresia1; PPHN2; true false positive2
individual_diagnoses: TGA x1; pulmonary valve atresia x1; PPHN x2; true false positive x2
lesion_mapping_status: Standalone TGA1 is definite harmonized CCHD. Pulmonary valve atresia lacks septal anatomy: if PA/IVS it is unconditional CCHD; otherwise a PA/VSD-type lesion would require <=28-day death/intervention, which is not documented. Therefore denominator is bounded 4-5.
management_actionability_evidence: Both PPHN infants were promptly treated -> CAN-A2. If pulmonary atresia remains in denominator it is CAN-U1 because no participant-specific qualifying management is reported. The two source true false positives have no qualifying condition -> aggregate NON_CAN2.
poolability_reason: complete final-fail classification but pulmonary-atresia anatomy prevents a single harmonized denominator/weight
source_full_text_provenance: Sola A et al. Int J Neonatal Screen. 2020;6(1):21. PMCID PMC7422978; DOI 10.3390/ijns6010021.
extraction_notes: If pulmonary valve atresia is PA/IVS: denom4, Strict2, Expanded2, NON_CAN2. If it remains harmonized-negative: denom5, Strict2, Expanded3, NON_CAN2. Retain report_cluster/program_cluster R125_SIBEN_2020 for robust sensitivity analysis.
